title: Mill 2 Discharge Pump 606 and 607 Suction Valve Delay Timer (Debounce)

fields.nextAction: Confirm which change owns PCSCR-554 and renumber the other
fields.statusConflict: Register 'In Development' vs meeting action 'Cancelled'; Register title 'HPGR 1 & 2 Shutdown Alarm Indication' (Benjamin Ratcliffe) does not match the signed PCSCR-554 form (Michael Phillips, Level 1 signed 30/05/2025) – possible duplicate PCSCR number; form area ticks Flotation although equipment is Mill 2
fields.why:
Mill 2 discharge pumps 606/607 suction valves are passing when showing closed causing excessive spillage on the floor.
[Image in form – see source document] (SCADA screenshot with the two suction valves arrowed)
fields.design:
Introduce a debounce of 10s (or until fully closed in the field) to ensure the suction valves are closed.

The suction valves requiring the delay timer:
- 234-XV-3059
- 234-XV-3063
fields.impact: Suction valves will only report closed once fully closed in the field, reducing spillage around the Mill 2 discharge pumps.
